title: fsl-testgen plugin protocol 1: request
description: The one JSON document fsl-testgen writes to the standard input of an external target executable, followed by a newline. `input` has passed every cross-check of fsl-testgen before the executable is started.

input.description: The testgen-input.v1 document, with its members in the order `fslc testgen-input` wrote them. That order is part of the contract: print state objects, parameter objects and scenarios in the order given.

unwired.description: What the generated suite must do while its adapter is not wired. `fail` (the default): every generated test fails. `skip` (`--allow-unwired`): every generated test is skipped; a plugin whose framework cannot skip at run time answers with an error diagnostic instead of generating a suite that passes.

spec_path.description: `--spec-path` as given on the command line, or null. Relative paths are relative to the directory fsl-testgen was started in, which is not necessarily the plugin's.

output.description: `-o` or `--out-dir` as given on the command line, or null when the result is printed. For information only: the plugin does not write.
